This [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] '''clan''' was one of the many clans that prospective [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|young Jedi]] were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Its members were just beginning their training; with the ages averaging around three standard years old. The Clan was trained by a Jedi Master; at the time of the [[Incident at the Jedi Temple]], the clan was tended to by [[Ali-Alann]].

During a string of robberies at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the clan was aboard a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] that ran horizontally across the [[Lake level|Lake Level]]. The shaft was sabotaged as the group was traveling to a [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|refectory]]. When the sabotaged shaft fell apart; leaving the car dangling over the lake, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was not a member of the Jedi Order at the time, was forced to help evacuate the younglings onto one of the catwalks. With the arrival of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] members, the group was swiftly brought down to safety.
